free-african-society-founded.research_focus: 1787 Philadelphia mutual aid society, Black churchgoers and tradesmen in late 18th century dress
free-african-society-founded.scene: A small group of Black men and women in plain late 18th-century clothes sit around a wooden table in a candlelit meeting room, a ledger and a coin box open between them.

walkers-appeal-pamphlet.research_focus: 1829 Boston pamphlet printing, Walker's used-clothing shop, hand-press era
walkers-appeal-pamphlet.scene: In a cramped Boston clothing shop, a man in a waistcoat stitches thin printed pamphlets into the lining of a coat on a counter, a hand press and hanging garments behind him.

crandall-school-black-girls.research_focus: 1833 Canterbury Connecticut Crandall academy, schoolroom, girls in 1830s dress
crandall-school-black-girls.scene: A 1830s New England schoolroom where a young teacher in a plain bonnet and dress stands at a slate board teaching a row of Black girls seated at wooden desks, while through the window a hostile crowd gathers.

fourteenth-amendment-ratified.research_focus: 1868 Reconstruction era, state legislature ratification, Black citizens in Southern city
fourteenth-amendment-ratified.scene: On a Southern courthouse step in the 1860s, a crowd of newly freed Black men and women in work clothes and Sunday hats listens as a man in a frock coat reads from a large parchment.

fifteenth-amendment-ratified.research_focus: 1870 Reconstruction, first Black voters at the ballot box, period engraving style
fifteenth-amendment-ratified.scene: A line of Black men in 1870s suits and hats waits patiently at an outdoor polling place, the first in line dropping a folded paper ballot into a wooden ballot box.

wells-southern-horrors.research_focus: 1892 Memphis, Ida B. Wells newspaper office, journalist at desk, 1890s dress
wells-southern-horrors.scene: A Black woman journalist in a high-collared 1890s dress writes at a cluttered desk in a newspaper office, stacks of papers and a printed pamphlet in front of her, a gas lamp overhead. Not a lynching scene.

gandhi-thrown-off-train.research_focus: 1893 Pietermaritzburg railway station, 1890s first-class carriage, lawyer in Western suit
gandhi-thrown-off-train.scene: On a dim 1890s railway platform at night, a young Indian lawyer in a dark suit and turban sits on a bench beside his luggage, a steam train pulling away behind him. A figure by posture only, no likeness.

du-bois-souls-black-folk.research_focus: 1903 scholar at desk with manuscript and book, Atlanta study, early 1900s dress
du-bois-souls-black-folk.scene: A scholar in a three-piece suit and pince-nez sits at a rolltop desk in a book-lined study, a stack of manuscript pages and a freshly bound dark cloth book in front of him.

garvey-founds-unia.research_focus: 1914 Kingston Jamaica, UNIA parade, banners, uniforms, early 1900s
garvey-founds-unia.scene: A parade of Black men and women in neat white and dark uniforms marches down a Kingston street under a banner and a red, black and green flag, with a drummer at the front and onlookers on balconies.

first-pan-african-congress-paris.research_focus: 1919 Paris Grand Hotel meeting hall, delegates in formal suits from Africa, Caribbean, America
first-pan-african-congress-paris.scene: Around sixty delegates in formal 1919 suits and a few in robes sit in rows in an ornate Paris meeting hall, one speaker standing at a lectern beneath tall windows.

pullman-porters-union.research_focus: 1925 Harlem Black Pullman porters in uniform, sleeping car, union meeting
pullman-porters-union.scene: A group of Black Pullman porters in white-collared dark uniforms and caps crowd into a Harlem meeting hall, one standing to address them with a raised hand, a sleeping-car porter's lantern on the table.

executive-order-8802.research_focus: 1941 defense plant, Black workers in war factory, aircraft assembly line
executive-order-8802.scene: In a 1940s aircraft factory, Black and white workers in overalls stand side by side at a long assembly line fitting a bomber's wing, an American flag hanging from the rafters.

truman-desegregates-military.research_focus: 1948 desegregated military unit, soldiers in 1940s uniforms, executive order document and pen
truman-desegregates-military.scene: Black and white soldiers in 1940s olive uniforms stand together in a single rank on a parade ground, and in the foreground a fountain pen rests on a signed official document on a desk.

mlk-day-signed.research_focus: 1983 White House Rose Garden signing, bill and pen, ceremonial desk, crowd of onlookers
mlk-day-signed.scene: A ceremonial desk on a sunlit lawn holds a thick signed bill and a gold pen beside a framed photograph of a preacher at a pulpit, with rows of empty folding chairs facing it. No recognisable person.

tutu-nobel-peace-prize.research_focus: 1984 Nobel Peace Prize medal and diploma, Oslo, Cape Town cathedral, purple cassock
tutu-nobel-peace-prize.scene: A gold Nobel medal and a diploma lie on a table in front of the stained-glass windows of a Cape Town cathedral, with a folded purple cassock beside them. No people.
